_doc: Pi-mono settings for the operator agent on .93. 2026-05-13 v3: switched default mid→ops. Reframed objective: hermes-agent is the customer, not pi-op. Pi-op-react every 60min × ~30 internal tool calls was consuming the SAME provider budgets hermes uses (gpt-4.1-mini in mid, etc.) — even with CB-skip-guard the upstream quotas still get spent. The new 'ops' pool routes pi-op exclusively to cerebras/llama-3.1-8b + groq/llama-3.1-8b-instant + groq/gpt-oss-20b — 14400 RPD each, zero overlap with hermes's user-facing pools. Thinking stays low.
